title: BSN Clinical Coordinator
description:
Position Overview

The BSN Clinical Coordinator manages the administrative,
logistical, and compliance processes that support clinical
education throughout the Bachelor of Science in Nursing program.
The coordinator works with students, faculty, clinical instructors,
preceptors, healthcare partners, and University offices to support
clinical placements, onboarding, scheduling, documentation, and
evaluation across undergraduate nursing courses.

Responsibilities

Coordinate undergraduate clinical placements, student groups,
schedules, assignments, and communications across BSN clinical
courses.

Maintain current records for clinical sites, affiliation
agreements, clinical instructors, preceptors, student placements,
evaluations, and required documentation.

Coordinate student and clinical-instructor onboarding and
verify completion of health, safety, background, training,
certification, and site-specific requirements.

Serve as a primary point of contact for BSN students, faculty,
clinical instructors, preceptors, clinical partners, and University
offices regarding clinical education processes.

Support the recruitment, orientation, scheduling, and ongoing
communication of clinical instructors and preceptors in
collaboration with nursing leadership and course faculty.

Monitor clinical capacity, placement needs, scheduling
conflicts, and student progression considerations; communicate
concerns and support timely resolution.

Coordinate the distribution, collection, and tracking of
clinical evaluations, attendance information, and other required
experiential-learning records.

Prepare clinical education data and documentation for program
evaluation, continuous improvement, regulatory reporting, and
accreditation activities.

Contribute to the development and maintenance of clinical
education procedures, student and instructor guidance, orientation
materials, and program resources.

Participate in program, department, college, and
clinical-partner meetings and perform other duties that support the
BSN program.


Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree

Experience in higher education, healthcare, clinical education,
program coordination, or a related setting.

Strong organizational, communication, customer-service, and
problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities, detailed records,
deadlines, and confidential student information.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability
to learn clinical-placement, learning-management, and data
systems.

Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with students,
faculty, staff, clinical partners, and external stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience coordinating nursing or other health-professions
clinical education.

Experience with clinical affiliation agreements, student
compliance, onboarding, scheduling, or placement systems.

Knowledge of nursing education accreditation, regulatory
expectations, and clinical-site requirements.

About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
